description:
AWS on Thursday said that it was upgrading the runtime layer of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with greater compute capacity, more efficient memory utilization, and faster startup times to help enterprises deploy and scale AI agents more quickly and cost-effectively.

The greater compute capacity includes support for up to four times more compute than the previous version, with each session now supporting up to eight virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 32GB of memory, the hyperscaler said in a statement.

description:
Google has announced Gemini Decisions API, offering developers a way to handle routine decisions in AI applications without generating text responses, weeks after OpenAI launched a competing service.

Powered by the company’s new Gemini Decision 1 model, the API allows developers to evaluate up to 1,000 questions in a single request. Unlike conventional generative AI models that produce responses token by token, the system assigns probabilities to specified options, allowing applications to make decisions without waiting for a generated answer.

description:
When Microsoft started to deploy AI models in what is now its Foundry platform, it was building on its partnership with OpenAI. OpenAI was able to use Azure infrastructure to train its models, and in return, Microsoft became the first commercial partner to use them.

Azure OpenAI has been a successful product for both businesses. But as more organizations got access to OpenAI models, Microsoft’s stable of models grew to include not only OpenAI’s, but also models from Anthropic and Hugging Face, as well as models from Meta, Mistral, and DeepSeek. description: As consumer-grade hardware makes hosting local AI practical for both developers and enterprises, many are discovering that popular open-weight models come with hardcoded safety filters and state-mandated biases. In this article, I will show how to use abliteration — a representation engineering technique — to surgically delete refusal vectors from the Qwen 3.8 27B model without expensive fine-tuning or full retraining. I stumbled into this barrier firsthand while running a simple experiment. title: The sketch Qwen refused to write: How abliteration restores local AI control
